content.text: `append` needs one qubit argument per instruction qubit, not a list of registers. Flattening the registers in the supplied order fixes the mismatch and supports variable register lengths without changing the circuit’s mapping.

input.arguments: {"command":"\"$PY\" -c \"from pathlib import Path; p = Path('buggy.py'); s = p.read_text(); s = s.replace('circ.append(oracle, [train_register, control])', 'circ.append(oracle, [*train_register, *control])'); p.write_text(s)\"; \"$PY\" buggy.py"}
